events.title: Halloween 2026
events.text: An unknown disease has spread from The Lab and contaminated the whole Tarkov region.

events.title: Halloween Twitch Drops
events.text: Watch Tarkov streams on Twitch to earn special Halloween drops. Rewards were available in all game modes.

events.title: Tarkov City Twitch Drops
events.text: Watch Tarkov streams on Twitch for in-game containers. The daily final reward is one of two PMC shirts: USEC Hangover Avenger (Nov 16, 18, 20, 22) or BEAR Cocktail Criminal (Nov 17, 19, 21). Link your Twitch and Battlestate accounts first.
